subject: The one feature 90% of users skip for 3 weeks
preview_text: You've been using Smart Notes for 22 days and still haven't tried this. It's the secret weapon for meetings.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing usage data this morning and noticed something interesting. You've been capturing meetings for three weeks now, but there's one button you've never pressed. It's the difference between taking notes and actually controlling the conversation.

Most people think they're using the app right. They record, get the summary, and move on. But the real power users—the ones who look like they have a photographic memory in meetings—they all do one thing differently. They don't just capture what's said. They shape what happens next.

That untouched button is 'Action Item Tracking.' It doesn't just list tasks from your meeting. It turns your notes into a command center. Every decision, every 'we should,' every vague promise gets transformed into a living document that follows up FOR you. The AI doesn't just summarize—it holds people accountable by auto-generating follow-up emails from action items.

Open Smart Notes right now and tap the 'Actions' tab. You'll see every commitment from your last 22 days, waiting to be tracked. I'll show you how to set it up in 60 seconds. P.S. The first person who tried this feature told me it made her look so organized her boss asked if she was taking Adderall.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
